engineeringChanges.verificationMethod: Node VM executes shipped helpers with controlled transaction completion/rejection; six failures reproduced before fix, eight tests pass after fix
engineeringChanges.result: Single-chart and summary writes, and deletes, publish cache changes only after persistent commit; temporary-mode and bulk-import compatibility tests pass
engineeringChanges.limitation: Controlled completion tests do not replace real-browser IndexedDB rollback/reopen or device tests

engineeringChanges.verificationMethod: Execute shipped Engine.start/resume with deferred audio activation; four cancellation/supersession cases fail before fix and pass after; active resume still reaches playback
engineeringChanges.result: Revalidate transition token and running state before touching UI or starting music after audio session activation
engineeringChanges.limitation: Tests isolate activation boundary; real Safari audio lifecycle and other asynchronous playback boundaries remain outside this result

engineeringChanges.verificationMethod: 18 transport regressions; original 12 cases had 10 failures before the fix. Real decoded Web Audio browser test fails on parent source and passes on final source.
engineeringChanges.result: Cancelled or superseded context activation/buffer waits cannot start music or switch transport; old start/resume completions and watchdog callbacks cannot pause or mutate replacement playback.
engineeringChanges.limitation: Controlled asynchronous boundaries and real Chromium playback; no physical Safari latency or official timing equivalence measurement.

engineeringChanges.verificationMethod: Local equivalent commands and parsed workflow YAML; remote result must be read for the final SHA.
engineeringChanges.result: PR checks install browser tooling before the Node suite, use explicit bash pipefail, and upload browser evidence. Initial false-green run is recorded in docs/evidence/2026-11-10/ci-first-run.json; final SHA requires raw-log verification.

engineeringChanges.verificationMethod: Original worker: eight new unit cases fail and actual updated-worker offline reload fails. Final worker: 18 SW tests and nine actual-worker browser steps pass with gzip transport, controlled missing bootstrap, retry, and isolated saved-data/range checks.
engineeringChanges.result: Prepare entry and HTML-declared startup code before activating; keep the existing working worker on failed install; preserve shared media cache and test saves.
engineeringChanges.limitation: Only program startup resources, not complete song/artwork/font/optional-resource offline coverage; real user/device/Safari and official UI fidelity unverified.

engineeringChanges.verificationMethod: Actual More action exposes aria-expanded=true but import action remains hidden before the selector correction. Final Chromium checks three viewports and native directory chooser; nested same-name media are checked against independent Node SHA-256 expectations.
engineeringChanges.result: Restore the existing import panel; nested folder import and prior-data/reload checks pass without changing importer logic, formats or menu contents.
engineeringChanges.limitation: Synthetic PGR folder and Chromium only; no exhaustive format/device/user-save or official-UI equivalence conclusion.

engineeringChanges.verificationMethod: Before: 9/10 new controlled lifecycle cases fail and actual HTML media is paused by a late recovery completion. After: 19 combined buffer cases, real-media ordering checks and full 456-test suite pass.
engineeringChanges.result: Cancellation releases the recovery slot and closes its input interval immediately; stale progress/finally callbacks cannot clear the new recovery or pause replacement music.
engineeringChanges.limitation: Actual media and Engine methods with controlled fallback/readiness/promise ordering; no live-network frequency, physical latency, Safari or official rule equivalence result.

engineeringChanges.verificationMethod: Before: 9/11 controlled cases fail and native HTML media resumes muted, then old fulfillment pauses/rewinds it. After: 44 combined lifecycle cases, three real-media ordered scenarios and full 467-test suite pass.
engineeringChanges.result: Current transport cancels its owned temporary prime state before reuse; only the matching prime completion/timeout may restore mute/position.
engineeringChanges.limitation: Actual media, resume/countdown and timeout with delayed promise observation; no organic network/Safari, physical latency or official-equivalence conclusion.
